prompt: Create a vertical fashion editorial portrait at an ancient Greek temple ruin in bright natural daylight. A young East Asian woman with dark brown shoulder-length hair stands in a relaxed three-quarter pose slightly right of center, head tilted down and eyes softly lowered, with a calm introspective expression. Wind blows loose strands of hair across her face. She wears an airy white sheer linen button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, open collar, and the front tied in a knot at the waist, paired with high-waisted cream trousers and a matching cream belt with a rectangular buckle. Add delicate gold jewelry: small dangling earrings and a fine necklace with a small pendant. Background: sunlit classical stone columns and marble ruins resembling the Parthenon, softly blurred with shallow depth of field, warm beige stone tones, pale blue sky, scattered ancient blocks underfoot, and a few tiny distant tourists barely visible. Camera and composition: medium portrait from thighs to head, 2:3 vertical crop, subject occupying the right half while temple columns fill the left background, natural perspective, editorial travel-fashion photography. Lighting and style: warm Mediterranean sunlight, soft shadows, subtle film grain, creamy highlights, muted ivory and sand palette, realistic skin texture, elegant minimal styling. Add a small white bottom-center brand mark reading WILDCORE | Kuro in a clean spaced sans-serif plus handwritten script style. Avoid extra text, logos, heavy makeup, exaggerated posing, or modern city elements.

promptZh: 在明亮的自然光下，创作一张以古希腊神庙遗迹为背景的竖版时尚编辑人像。一位年轻的东亚女性，留着 深棕色齐肩发，以放松的三分之二侧身姿势站在画面中心偏右的位置，头部微垂，双眼轻闭，神情平静而内敛。微风吹拂，几缕发丝掠过她的脸庞。她穿着一件轻盈的 白色透视亚麻衬衫，袖口卷起，领口敞开，下摆在腰间打结，搭配高腰米色长裤和一条带有矩形扣的同色系腰带。佩戴精致的金色首饰：小巧的垂坠耳环和一条带有小吊坠的细项链。背景：阳光照射下的古典石柱和类似帕特农神庙的大理石遗迹，背景虚化，呈现浅景深效果，色调为温暖的米色石材，天空呈淡蓝色，脚下散落着古老的石块，远处隐约可见几位微小的游客。相机与构图：中景人像（从大腿到头部），2:3 竖构图，主体占据画面右侧，神庙石柱填充左侧背景，自然视角，编辑类旅游时尚摄影。光影与风格：温暖的地中海阳光，柔和的阴影，细腻的胶片颗粒感，奶油色高光，柔和的象牙白与沙色调，真实的皮肤质感，优雅极简的造型。在底部中心添加一个白色小品牌标识，文字为 WILDCORE | Kuro，采用简洁的间距无衬线字体加手写体风格。避免出现多余文字、Logo、浓妆、夸张姿势或现代城市元素。
